main_text.p: ηᾶλλιων ον@ ο ἡ in n.g. ηᾶλλιον melius, capitur Adverbialiter Actor.25.10. Superl. ηᾶλλιστ@, optimus, pulcerrimus. τὸ καλὸν (substantivè) decus, commodum, honestas.
Καλῶς adv. bene, Marc.7.37. probe, recte. comp. ηᾶλλιον melius.
Καλύπτω operio. F. καλύψω, Jac.5.20. a.1.act. ἐκάλυψα, aor.1.act. imperat. ηᾶλυψον ἀπω. pras.pass. καλύπτομαι tegor. prat.pass. κεκα-λυμμαι. part.prat.pass. κεκαλυμμένος η ον tectus a um.
Καμηλ@ ὁ camelus, Matth.3.4. item funis nauticus, Luc.18.25.
Καμμύω (pro καταμύω) proprie, claudo oculos, conniveo. Fut.ὑσω. a.1. ἐκάμμυσα pro κατεμυσα, Matth.13.15. P. κεκάμμυκα pro κατεμμυκα. ex ἡ ἐμύω claudo, occludo, comprimo. F.μύσω. P.μέμυκα.
Κάμνω laboro, aegroto, Jacob.5.15. Fut. καμῶ. P. κέκμηκα defatigatus fui. a.2. ἐκαμον. a.2. subj. κάμω ης η, Heb.12.3. ἵνα μὴ κάμητε (2.pl. a.2.subj.act.) ne fatisfactis.
Καμπτω flecto. F. κάμψω. P. κεκαμφα. a.1. ἐκαμψα, Rom.11.4. a.1.act.subj. κάμψω ης η.
Καν etsi, quamvis. conjunct. difcr. ex ἡ & αν si. & si Marc.5.28. Heb.12.20. saltem Marc.6.56. Act.5.15.
Κανὼν ὁν@ ὁ regula, mensura, Gal.6.16.

page.notes: Right margin notes are heavily damaged and cut off at the page edge; largely illegible, so not transcribed in full. Greek accents and breathings in the lexicon entries are doubtful in places. The catchword "Καπη-" is partly visible at the foot of the column.
